notes: Pilot slice for shape review. Source mix: 12 lifted+reskinned from P1 May/Jun 2025 Q2.3 (eThekwini water tariff), 12 fresh with two inline tariff stimuli.

stimulus.alt: Table of eThekwini Municipality domestic water tariffs per kℓ, with five consumption bands (0-6, 6-25, 25-30, 30-45, >45 kℓ) across three financial years (Feb 2022, 2023, 2024). All tariffs exclude 15% VAT.

items.question: What is the tariff per kℓ for monthly consumption in the 0-6 kℓ band in February 2024?
workingSteps: Read the row '0-6 kℓ' and the column 'Feb 2024 Tariff'.

items.question: How many consumption bands are listed in the tariff table?
workingSteps: Count the rows of consumption bands in the table.

items.question: Are the tariffs in the table inclusive or exclusive of VAT?
options: VAT is not applicable to water
workingSteps: Read the footnote: 'All tariffs exclude 15% VAT.'

items.question: What is the tariff per kℓ for monthly consumption of more than 45 kℓ in February 2022?
workingSteps: Read the row 'More than 45 kℓ' and the column 'Feb 2022 Tariff'.

items.question: A household used 15 kℓ of water in February 2024. Which tariff band do they fall in?
workingSteps: 15 kℓ is between 6 kℓ and 25 kℓ, so it falls in the second band.

items.question: What is the tariff per kℓ for consumption in the 25-30 kℓ band in February 2023?
workingSteps: Read row 'More than 25 kℓ to 30 kℓ' and column 'Feb 2023 Tariff'.

items.question: Calculate the increase in the per-kℓ tariff for the 6-25 kℓ band from February 2022 to February 2023.
In February 2022, what is the difference in per-kℓ tariff between the 6-25 kℓ band and the 25-30 kℓ band?
A household used exactly 6 kℓ of water in February 2024. What was their total water charge (excluding VAT)?
workingSteps: 6 kℓ falls entirely in the 0-6 kℓ band.
Tariff for 0-6 kℓ in Feb 2024 = R0,00/kℓ.

items.question: A household used 28 kℓ of water in February 2024. Calculate their total water charge (excluding VAT).
workingSteps: Split 28 kℓ into the three applicable bands.

items.question: What is the percentage increase in the per-kℓ tariff for the 6-25 kℓ band from February 2022 to February 2024? Round to one decimal place.
A household uses 12 kℓ of water each month. How much more do they pay (excluding VAT) in February 2024 compared to February 2022?
workingSteps: 12 kℓ = first 6 kℓ free + next 6 kℓ at the band rate.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_ROW_MISREAD: Reads the wrong tariff row (e.g. wrong consumption band)
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_COLUMN_MISREAD: Reads the wrong tariff column (e.g. wrong year/period)
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BAND_COUNT: Miscounts the number of tariff bands in a table
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_VAT_FOOTNOTE_MISSED: Fails to notice the VAT-inclusion footnote on a tariff
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_VAT_DOUBLE_APPLIED: Adds VAT to a total that already includes it
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BAND_BOUNDARY: Confuses which side of a band boundary a value falls on
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BLOCK_FLAT: Treats a stepped/block tariff as a single flat rate applied to all consumption
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_SUBSCRIPTION_FORGOTTEN: Omits the fixed monthly subscription when totalling a usage-based tariff
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_CROSSOVER_IGNORED: Picks one plan as 'always cheaper' without noting the consumption-dependent crossover
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_SUBTRACTION_ORDER: Subtracts in the wrong order (smaller − larger when larger − smaller intended)
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_CHANGE_DIVISOR: Divides a percentage change by the new value instead of the old/original value
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_EQUATION_SOLVE: Sets up or solves the equality incorrectly when finding a crossover
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE: Misclassifies the type of relationship (linear, constant, inverse, compound)
